items.title: Make every ranked General Manager command land on the exact decision surface it names
items.executionEvidence: One shared async navigation authority now activates and hydrates the owning tab, scrolls to and focuses the declared target, honors reduced-motion preference, and reports unavailable targets honestly. Command Center, mobile pressure, Blueprint, and season-chapter routes publish and consume exact target IDs; 37 focused tests and the rendered desktop/mobile dark/light command captures pass.
items.premise: The public game contract requires the active call to land on the exact tab and decision surface. Season chapters and Blueprint actions carry targetId, scroll, and focus, but Franchise Command Center cards carry only targetTab; the click handler merely activates that tab. franchiseArchitecture.js then hardcodes every non-advance Now target back to franchiseCommandCenter. Draft, cap, injury, deadline, and league-pulse commands therefore stop short of their named work surface.
evidence: public/lib/franchiseCommandCenter.js cards and receipt omit targetId
public/app.js Franchise Command Center handler activates only targetTab
public/app.js Blueprint and season-chapter paths duplicate scroll/focus behavior
public/lib/franchiseArchitecture.js maps non-advance targetId to franchiseCommandCenter
items.constraint: One navigation authority must preserve tab-island hydration, keyboard focus, reduced-motion-safe browser behavior, command ranking, simulation blocking, and truthful missing-target diagnostics. No inferred choice or automatic action.
verification: focused command-stack and exact-navigation unit tests
browser wiring and aggregate suite green
desktop/mobile dark/light rendered pixels for cap, injury, deadline, and draft routes
every command receipt publishes targetTab plus targetId

L1.recipe: Add explicit target IDs to command cards and focus those nodes after tab activation.

L2.recipe: Create one tested exact-surface navigation authority, route Command Center, Blueprint, and Season chapter actions through it, publish target IDs in explanation receipts, and verify cap/injury/deadline/draft behavior in rendered desktop/mobile themes.

L3.recipe: L2 plus persist anonymous local command-to-surface completion instrumentation for a future consented playtest cohort.

items.title: Expose the source-derived strongest Architect signature where dynasty decisions are reviewed
items.executionEvidence: The canonical mastery projection now publishes signature score, status, and source receipt count; Architecture Review renders the strongest evidence-backed identity beside focus and milestone information with an explicit no-hidden-bonus boundary and honest empty state. items.premise: architectMasteryPortfolio computes four evidence paths plus a strongest signature, focus, recommendation, and next milestone. The Overview renders the focus and all path scores, but no live UI reads mastery.signature. That leaves the dynasty-loop contract's strongest-signature promise computed but invisible, weakening the payoff for coherent long-career identity.
